verdict.rationale: Requesty's docs describe Fallback Policies that automatically retry a request on a different model when one fails, so the app stays up through provider issues [requesty-docs-3]. The router sends each request to the primary model first, then immediately tries the next model in the chain on a timeout, rate limit or error [requesty-docs-4]. missing for 10: detail on how the fallback chain is set up (UI vs. API, per-key vs. org-wide), and independent or hands-on confirmation that cross-provider failover works in practice.
